name: Klučov (Czechia)
description: Green field with a white cleaver blade laid diagonally between a yellow square with a hook and a yellow rake head.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 13 November 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: square with hook and rake head
